title: Fix flashlight FKey input exception
objective: Fix examples/flashlight/run.py so gamepad flashlight toggle does not crash with SPEAR engine_service Exception: 'FKey'.
instructions: Edit examples/flashlight/run.py only unless a directly necessary adjacent example reference proves unavoidable.
Use the user-provided runtime log as evidence: after logging Flashlight toggle key: Gamepad_FaceButton_Right, SPEAR raises engine_service Exception: 'FKey' and frame state becomes error.
Investigate why constructing or using game.get_unreal_object(uclass='FKey') fails in this runtime.
Prefer a robust existing SPEAR/Unreal input pattern from examples/enhanced_input/run.py or instance.input_service/enhanced_input_service if it avoids manual FKey construction.
If player_controller methods require an FKey but Python bridge cannot construct FKey directly, implement a safe alternative or revert to a method known to work in this repo.
Keep Xbox B as the default target if possible: Unreal Gamepad_FaceButton_Right.
expected_outputs: Root cause and fix summary for the FKey exception.
Manual verification command and exact Xbox button/key to test.
definition_of_done: examples/flashlight/run.py no longer constructs input keys in a way that raises Exception: 'FKey' at runtime.
